environment.description: Check the CLIs and tools used by multi-session workflows, with copyable repair commands for missing items.

preset.title: Choose your workbench mode
preset.description: The mode only sets initial module preferences. You can adjust every module later in Settings.

workspace.title: Create your first workspace
workspace.description: Gather related projects and working materials into a portable work context.

parallel.title: Launch two sessions side by side
parallel.description: Run two available agents in the same project and see parallel work immediately.

finish.title: Your workbench is ready
finish.description: Move from observing the workspace to dispatching and collaboration.

full.title: Full mode

minimal.title: Minimal mode
minimal.description: Keep terminals, projects, the editor, and launcher while hiding every optional module.

workspace.principleMaterials: Materials: designs, samples, and documents can sit beside code projects in one workspace.
